description: This file defines the public API for EEPROM drivers in the Zephyr project, including function prototypes, callback types, and API structures for reading, writing, and getting the size of EEPROM devices.

methods.name: eeprom_read
methods.description: Reads data from EEPROM device at specified offset into provided buffer.

methods.name: eeprom_write
methods.description: Writes data to EEPROM device at specified offset from provided buffer.

methods.name: eeprom_get_size
methods.description: Retrieves the total size of the EEPROM device in bytes.
